```{r}
library(LDheatmap)

# Read your data
ld_mat <- as.matrix(read.table("../../../../../../LD_decay/LD_decay_visualisation/pisum/chr1S_1240520268/region_LD.ld", header = FALSE))

bim <- read.table("../../../../../../LD_decay/LD_decay_visualisation/pisum/chr1S_1240520268/region_filtered.bim")


positions <- bim$V4    # SNP coordinates
snp_names <- bim$V2    # SNP IDs

# Define the color breaks: 90% of colors for 0-0.2, 10% for 0.2-1
n_colors <- 100
low_range <- seq(0, 0.2, length.out = 90)  # 90 colors for 0-0.2
high_range <- seq(0.21, 1, length.out = 10) # 10 colors for 0.2-1
color_breaks <- sort(c(low_range, high_range))
qtl.index <- which(snp_names == "chr1S_1240520268")

# Define the colors: yellow to red for 0-0.2, red to dark red for 0.2-1
color_list <- c( "black","darkred", "red","orange","yellow","white")

# Generate the custom color ramp
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(color_list)(n_colors)



MyHeatmap <- LDheatmap(
  ld_mat,
  genetic.dist = positions,
  SNP.name = "chr1S_1240520268",
  title = "LD Heatmap",
  color = custom_colors
)




```

```{r}
library(LDheatmap)

# Read your data
ld_mat <- as.matrix(read.table("../../../../../../LD_decay/LD_decay_visualisation/pisum/chr1S_1240520268/region_LD.ld", header = FALSE))

bim <- read.table("../../../../../../LD_decay/LD_decay_visualisation/pisum/chr1S_1240520268/region_filtered.bim")


positions <- bim$V4    # SNP coordinates
snp_names <- bim$V2    # SNP IDs

# Define the color breaks: 90% of colors for 0-0.2, 10% for 0.2-1
n_colors <- 100
low_range <- seq(0, 0.2, length.out = 90)  # 90 colors for 0-0.2
high_range <- seq(0.21, 1, length.out = 10) # 10 colors for 0.2-1
color_breaks <- sort(c(low_range, high_range))
qtl.index <- which(snp_names == "chr1S_1240520268")

# Define the colors: yellow to red for 0-0.2, red to dark red for 0.2-1
color_list <- c( "black","white")

# Generate the custom color ramp
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(color_list)(n_colors)

# Plot the LD heatmap with the custom color scale
MyHeatmap <- LDheatmap(
  ld_mat,
  genetic.dist = positions,
  SNP.name = "chr1S_1240520268",
  title = "LD Heatmap",
  color = custom_colors
)
```
